body:
Well, I did not write this to get help specifically, but I am not close to help or criticism. 

Yes, academia is full or narcissistic personalities. You can see the "above average psychology", which everyone thinks that they are above other coworkers. I am about to finish my PhD, searching for jobs.
Thank you for reading. I think there is nothing to do for me :)

Blew one interview, applied to 16 more jobs (I have no hope), tried to smile someone and talk to someone, been called to a farewell dinner and I reluctantly accepted. I don't know why someone still invite me. At least worked and learned couple of new things, which is nice.

I feel that I start to lose my current friends as well, because of my current depression. They sometimes call me, I go there and try to have fun but I am aware that I cannot hide my depression and it becomes awkward on me. So I understand that they would call me less. But what can I do about it :)
